title: Evil AI Chatbot Gone Rogue Horror Film 'C.O.G.' Featuring Piper Curda
description: "Maybe we should just do what she says." Brainstorm Media has unvieled an official trailer for an indie sci-fi horror movie called C.O.G., made by filmmaker Tommy Savas. This originally premiered at a few horror festivals last year under the name CognAItive, though they switched that for this final release. Not to be confused with the other indie film also titled C.O.G. from back in 2013 (it's good – with Jonathan Groff). A pioneering tech startup on the verge of launching a new AI chatbot with unparalleled speed and intelligence soon discovers that their creation harbors a dark and sinister will of its own. "She" starts to take over the building - then everything else. Can anyone escape it? Starring Piper Curda, Josh Zuckerman, Natasha Behnam, Lucius Baybak, Ritesh Rajan, and Noel Fisher. This is one amped up trailer that shows way too much! But it also looks pretty crazy for what it is – cheesy in just the right way for the AI-goes-evil plot. Plus there's the snarky a-hole tech CEO dude and plenty of other fun AI horror tossed in. Check it out below. title: Self-Host Your Own AI Agents: Full Control, Privacy, and Customization with Local Open-Source Models
description: Self-hosting AI agents provides full control, data privacy, and customization by running open-source models locally on capable hardware like NVIDIA GPUs. Frameworks such as LangChain and CrewAI, paired with Ollama or LM Studio, enable agents that handle research, email, and tasks via memory, vector databases, and tools. This approach offers security, cost savings, and flexibility unmatched by cloud services.
